title: Siri AI taps Google Gemini LLM technology, with future development focused on deep third-party app integration
summary: Siri AI taps Google Gemini LLM technology, with future development focused on deep third-party app integration digitimes
body: Siri AI taps Google Gemini LLM technology, with future development focused on deep third-party app integration digitimes
summaryZh: 据报道，苹果Siri AI将采用谷歌的Gemini大语言模型技术，未来的开发重点将放在深度的第三方应用程序整合上，标志着苹果在AI底层技术上与谷歌展开合作。原始信息显示：Siri AI taps Google Gemini LLM technology, with future development focused on deep third-party app integration digitimes。该消息由digitimes发布，主题为“Siri AI taps Google Gemini LLM technology, with future development focused on deep third-party app integration”。其重要性主要体现在：报道称Siri AI将采用Google Gemini大模型技术，未来侧重深度第三方应用整合。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
